product.name: KLOSIA Women's Printed Straight Kurta and Pant with Dupatta Set
product.product_type: Straight Kurta Pant and Dupatta Set
product.description: A printed straight kurta set for women consisting of a straight kurta, ankle-length pants and a printed dupatta. Designed for casual, festive and semi-formal occasions.

review_summary.summary: Customers generally respond positively to the kurta set, especially for comfort, fabric, appearance, fit, colours and value for money. Several reviewers describe it as suitable for daily wear and summer. The main concerns are that one reviewer found the colour faded, another said the fabric was not pure cotton and described it as mixed cotton, and one reviewer felt the dupatta could have been longer. The product listing itself specifies 100% viscose, so the cotton-related review should be treated as customer feedback rather than the official material specification.

buying_advice.size_advice: The product is available from S through 5XL and several reviewers reported good or accurate sizing. Customers should still check the size chart before ordering.
buying_advice.weather_advice: Several reviewers describe the set as comfortable and suitable for summer, making it a reasonable option for warm weather.
buying_advice.sales_advice: Lead with the elegant printed design, comfortable feel, broad size range, seven colour choices and strong value. shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_about_product: Give a concise overview covering the printed ethnic style, straight regular fit, 100% viscose material, 3/4 sleeves, ankle-length pants, price, colours, sizes and the most important review insights.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_if_good: Recommend it for customers looking for an affordable, comfortable ethnic kurta set. Highlight the positive comfort, design, fit and value feedback while disclosing the colour, dupatta-length and material-composition concerns when relevant.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_about_summer: This is a reasonable summer option because multiple reviewers describe it as comfortable or suitable for summer. Do not claim it is guaranteed to be cool or breathable.

shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_about_material: State that the official product specification lists 100% viscose and Rayon as the material type. If the customer asks specifically about cotton, disclose that one verified review described it as mixed cotton rather than pure cotton.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_about_colors: Mention that the collected product variants include Black, Blue, Green, Grey, Maroon, Morepeach and Orange. If the customer asks about colour brightness, mention that one reviewer found the black colour somewhat faded.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_about_dupatta: Explain that the set includes a printed dupatta. Several reviewers liked it, although one reviewer felt the dupatta could have been longer.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_for_alternatives: Prioritize other ethnic sets with similar pricing and styling, but prefer products with clearer material specifications if the customer's requirement is specifically pure cotton.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_for_best_product: Do not recommend this product solely because of its 4.2 rating. Consider the customer's budget, preferred material, size, colour, weather, occasion and requirement for dupatta length.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_for_pure_cotton: Do not describe this product as pure cotton. The official listing specifies 100% viscose, despite some customer feedback using cotton terminology.
